dog.description_text:
Since I'm a long stay pup, my adoption fee has been reduced! Visit me today to find out my favorite treats and how you can take me home!

My foster writes: If you're looking for a sweet and sleepy senior cuddle bug, look no further! After having this guy for a few months, we can definitely say that he treasures his beauty sleep. He is a professional daytime napper and, if you get up too early, he'll come get some pets and head right back to sleep! But don't let his sleepy demeanor fool you - he also has a playful side. When the mood strikes, he'll do the spins (jump around in a circle) and demand a whole 10 minutes of tussling before promptly returning to his bed for a snooze. He's housebroken, well-mannered, and an overall sweetie. Although he has no separation anxiety (and sometimes seems to appreciate a long, uninterrupted nap), he is more than happy to cuddle on the couch for movie marathons.

My foster writes: Flint is an absolute sweetheart and joy to be around. He's a professional snoozer, looking for love between naps. Even though he's a senior, he's got a puppy-like energy when it comes to getting excited for walks. It's very clear he looks to please, and may just need a little patience when it comes to his loss of hearing and figuring out how to communicate with him.

My foster writes:
Meet Flint! (Flintstone for long)
Flint is a sweet, easygoing boy who's happiest when he's being pet or snoozing the day away. He loves affection and will always lean in for extra scratches and cuddles. When he's not soaking up love, Flint spends most of his day sleeping and relaxing, making him a wonderful match for a calm, laid-back home. He's friendly and loving to everyone he meets!
Flint is crate trained, house trained, and does great settling in on his own, which makes transitions and daily routines nice and easy. He's a low-key companion who would thrive with someone looking for a gentle, affectionate dog that fits seamlessly into your life.
If you're searching for a mellow best friend with a big heart and a talent for naps, Flint might be the perfect addition to your family.

What my friends at ACC say about me:

I am a sweet, social, older gentleman, looking for the perfect forever home!

I'm ready to learn! I need a patient person who has the time to work on training with me.

I would do best in a home without very tiny humans, although I could be open to older human children once I meet them.
dog.name: Flint
